procedures.name: Main
procedures.source:
&DateValue = YMDToD(2024,1,31)
&DateOther = &DateValue.AddMonths(1)
Print(&DateOther.Year())
Print(&DateOther.Month())
Print(&DateOther.Day())
&DateOther = &DateValue.AddMonths(-1)
Print(&DateOther.Year())
Print(&DateOther.Month())
Print(&DateOther.Day())
&DateValue = YMDToD(2024,2,29)
&DateOther = &DateValue.AddYears(1)
Print(&DateOther.Year())
Print(&DateOther.Month())
Print(&DateOther.Day())
&DateOther = &DateValue.AddYears(-4)
Print(&DateOther.Year())
Print(&DateOther.Month())
Print(&DateOther.Day())
&DateValue.SetEmpty()
&DateOther = &DateValue.AddMonths(1)
Print(&DateOther.Year())
Print(&DateOther.Month())
Print(&DateOther.Day())
&DateOther = &DateValue.AddYears(1)
Print(&DateOther.Year())
Print(&DateOther.Month())
Print(&DateOther.Day())
